title: Secretary of State Active vs. Good Standing: What Lenders Need to Know
summary: Learn how active and good standing statuses differ and how lenders use registry data in KYB.
body_markdown:
When a lender verifies a small business, a Secretary of State (SOS) search helps establish whether the applicant is registered and authorized to operate. An active registration and a certificate of good standing are not necessarily interchangeable. Understanding the difference helps credit teams identify issues that need to be resolved before funding without unnecessarily declining otherwise eligible borrowers.


### What is the difference between active and good standing?


Active generally refers to a current entity registration that has not been terminated or suspended under the relevant state's definitions. Good standing generally indicates that an entity satisfies the state requirements for that status, which may include filings, fees or taxes. Some states use these terms interchangeably, while others maintain separate records.


A certificate of good standing, sometimes called a certificate of status or existence, provides official evidence from the issuing authority as of a particular date. An online registry result is not necessarily equivalent to a certificate. Neither status proves profitability, solvency, industry licensing or absence of fraud.


### Why can a business be active but not in good standing?


A company may appear active in one registry while a separate agency records an outstanding obligation. There may also be a delay between a missed filing, a notice of noncompliance and a formal status change. Cached vendor records can introduce additional timing differences.


Common issues to investigate include overdue annual reports, unpaid required fees or taxes, missing registered agent information where applicable, and problems with foreign registration. The legal effects depend on the jurisdiction and entity type.


#### Status reference table for lenders


Status Typical meaning Illustrative lender action


Active or good standing Current registration or compliance status Continue KYB; obtain certificate if required


Active with delinquency Outstanding obligation or conflicting record Verify and assess remediation


Suspended or forfeited State action affecting entity rights Escalate and review reinstatement


Dissolved or canceled Termination or cancellation Pause ordinary funding and seek legal review


No match or unknown Search mismatch or missing record Check identifiers and alternate evidence


These are illustrative workflow outcomes, not universal credit rules. Establish criteria with legal and compliance teams.


### How status varies by state


**California:** The[Secretary of State](https://www.sos.ca.gov/business-programs/business-entities/cbs-field-status-definitions) distinguishes active entities from suspended or forfeited entities. Missing Statements of Information or tax obligations can trigger suspension by the relevant agency. A certificate of status is available separately.


**Texas:** The[Comptroller's franchise tax account status](https://comptroller.texas.gov/taxes/franchise/coas-instructions.php) addresses the right to transact business. Lenders should distinguish this tax-related record from Secretary of State registration filings and obtain the appropriate evidence for the transaction.


**Delaware:** The[Division of Corporations](https://corp.delaware.gov/onlinestatus/) offers online status checks, but those checks do not generate an official good standing certificate. A separate request is necessary when formal evidence is required.


For businesses operating across state lines, verify formation-state status and relevant foreign registrations separately. A problem in one jurisdiction does not automatically establish the same status everywhere.


### How to use registry status in KYB and underwriting


Start by matching the legal business name, entity number, formation jurisdiction and available address information against the application. A DBA or spelling variation should prompt further verification rather than an immediate decline.


Capture the original status label, source jurisdiction, retrieval timestamp and supporting evidence. If a provider normalizes several state-specific labels into one category, preserve the underlying record so an underwriter can understand the result.


Build a policy that differentiates an acceptable registration, a remediable discrepancy and a material legal restriction. An overdue filing could trigger a request for evidence of reinstatement, while a dissolved entity could require legal escalation. Recheck unresolved cases before funding and consider monitoring material status changes after funding.


Registry information belongs alongside identity verification, ownership checks where applicable, fraud screening, credit information and cash-flow assessment. See Lendflow's guides to[KYB verification](https://www.lendflow.com/post/kyb-verification) and[selecting a KYB provider](https://www.lendflow.com/post/best-kyb-provider-for-lending-platforms) .


### Getting Secretary of State data through an API


[Middesk](https://www.middesk.com/feature/secretary-of-state-api) offers registration verification through an API, while[OpenCorporates](https://knowledge.opencorporates.com/knowledge-base/api-documentation/) provides programmatic access to company registry data. Their products are not necessarily interchangeable.


Ask which jurisdictions and entity types are covered, how frequently records refresh, whether queries are live or cached, whether raw status labels are available and how no-match responses are handled. Confirm whether official certificates can be obtained separately and whether monitoring events are supported.


With[Lendflow Intelligence](https://www.lendflow.com/lendflow-intelligence) , lending teams can bring verification signals into configurable underwriting workflows rather than treating registry status as a standalone credit decision.


### Frequently asked questions


#### Is an active business automatically in good standing?


No universal rule applies. Some states use the terms interchangeably, but separate filing or tax records may require verification.


#### Should lenders decline businesses that are not in good standing?


Not automatically. Assess the reason, legal restrictions, remediation options and lending policy.


#### Which companies provide Secretary of State business data via API?


Middesk and OpenCorporates are examples. Evaluate coverage, freshness and certificate availability for your specific workflow.
